identity.title: Pokémon Battle: Pikachu's Big Exciting Adventure

leadText:
(Japanese: ポケモンバトル:ピカチュウのわくわく大ぼうけん Pokémon Battle: Pikachu's Big Exciting Adventure) is a Pokémon manga created by Miho Asada. It is one of the manga adaptations of , with one of its chapters based on The Green Guardian. It appeared in SHO★1 (小学一年生), starting from April 2005.
